pages.text: Away from the Gland my pools run dry and stay dry. The Chronocortex can grow a cure: a $(l)locket$() on a living cord.$(br2)Research it, then use it on an organism's $(l)Tap$() to tie it there. Worn in the $(l)necklace$() slot, it draws a little of that organism's essence into me every two seconds while I stay within forty-eight blocks.

pages.title: Lost Lockets
pages.text: If I lose it, the Chronocortex will grow another for the same essence and materials. It remembers how; I need not find the clues again.
